description: This file defines a utility enum `GenericPasswordKeychainStore` for managing Keychain items, providing methods to load, save, and delete password strings associated with a service and account. It encapsulates Keychain access logic using Security framework functions.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string value from the Keychain for a given service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the Keychain for a given service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the Keychain item for a given service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve raw data from the Keychain.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Internal method to save raw data to the Keychain.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base query dictionary for Keychain operations.
